title: The rebalance storm: when slow looks dead
story: A payments team consumes an orders topic with three workers. A database migration makes each record slower to process. Nobody's consumer crashes, yet within minutes the group is stuck in a loop of rebalances and lag is climbing.

title: Saved, refreshed, reverted: replica lag
story: A profile service writes to a Postgres primary and serves reads from two streaming replicas. It has worked for years. This afternoon a user renames herself, gets a green 'Saved', hits refresh, and her old name is back.

title: The cold cache: a deploy that forgot everything
story: A shop's product pages are served from Redis 96% of the time, and Postgres only sees the misses. A routine Thursday deploy rolls out across six web pods. Nothing in it touches the database, yet within a minute the site is returning 504s.

title: 43 seconds, 24 hours: GitHub's split brain
story: October 21, 2018, 22:52 UTC. Engineers replace a failing 100G optic at GitHub's US East Coast network hub, a routine job. Orchestrator watches over the MySQL clusters from three sites. Real time is compressed here: the first two minutes play close to real time, then each second stands for several minutes of a 24-hour recovery.
